subject.title: Feature: Dynamic header templating for custom LLM providers (enables Fireworks.ai prompt caching)

question: Should OpenClaw add a generic runtime placeholder contract for provider headers, or limit this to provider-specific/session-affinity and explicit run-context header mapping features?
rationale: The remaining work is technically feasible, but choosing the public config contract, allowed identity fields, privacy/security rules, and overlap with open related PRs requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve narrow generic placeholders
options.body: Implement only explicit placeholders such as `{{session.key}}`, `{{agent.id}}`, and `{{run.id}}` in provider request headers with docs, security notes, and tests for unchanged static headers.

options.title: Prefer explicit header mapping
options.body: Use the narrower run-context header mapping and provider-specific affinity paths instead of accepting template strings inside arbitrary header values.

options.title: Defer for privacy design
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers define which runtime identifiers may be sent to external providers and how users should opt in.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow generic placeholders
recommendation.body: Implement only explicit placeholders such as `{{session.key}}`, `{{agent.id}}`, and `{{run.id}}` in provider request headers with docs, security notes, and tests for unchanged static headers.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is currently assigned to Takhoffman, making them the clearest available owner for the human product/security choice.
